text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed an appeal from the owner of 95 Ellins Avenue for front yard parking. Front yard parking at this location is not recommended because it does not meet the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 918 in that the licensing of a front yard parking pad is not permitted where parking can be provided on private property and for corner properties, the parking space is to be situated on the boulevard of the flanking street. The owner will be given an opportunity to make a deputation before Community Council.

Etobicoke York Community Council approved the request for front yard parking at 95 Ellins Avenue, with the following conditions: 1. The parking area be a minimum of 2.2 metres in width and not exceed 2.6 metres and a minimum of 5.3 metres and not exceed 5.9 metres in length. 2. The applicant disconnect any downspouts, if feasible, or seek an exemption from Toronto Water in accordance with the requirements in Chapter 681-11(S). 3. The proposed parking space to be relocated to private property, as shown on the revised sketch dated January 16, 2018. 4. The applicant pay all applicable fees and comply with all other criteria set out in the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 918, Parking on Residential Front Yards and Boulevards.
